scope: T0 auxiliary observation revisions; T9 party consistency and noncash closure dates; T1 inference-only live endpoint and complete-horizon paired validation
covered_behaviors: Customer/promise/outflow updates preserve prior snapshot hashes and encrypted versions
Legacy current observation survives first versioned update; same-day conflicting updates roll back atomically
Invoice party correction cannot inherit a previously approved allocation; ledger reversal remains available
Late/same-day credit note closes debt without backdating a cash settlement label
Late-known historical credits and changed face amounts do not become future cash labels
Live T1/T4 path cannot fit or build training labels; selected T1 or B1d is used
New revenue omission is explicit in the API and dashboard
Horizon scores include fully followed unpaid invoices and compare B1d on identical rows
Insufficient horizon follow-up yields excluded counts and null scores rather than fake negative labels
Retrain persists complete-horizon metrics without activating the candidate automatically
limitations: Past revisions already overwritten before this implementation cannot be reconstructed without source data
Knowledge-time resolution is one day; conflicting observation edits on the same knowledge day are rejected
Face-amount changes and identity changes exclude affected historical origins instead of reconstructing old targets
Validation is conditional on complete horizon follow-up; noncash censoring may be informative
Service registry currently selects T1 only; new revenue is not modelled without a selected T4 artifact
Genuine historic allocation onboarding and real-domain quality evaluation remain separate work
UI text and JavaScript were checked statically; browser rendering was not verified
quality_claim: Technical regression only; no new real-domain matching quality or forecast efficacy claim; historical gate evidence unchanged
